messages:
sanjay: FYI saw backup pipeline failing since 07:10 UTC, error is KMS DecryptAccessDenied when trying to restore snapshot :exclamation:
emma: ugh, which principal is hitting KMS? logs?
devon: CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt denied for ARN arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/backup-operator/service-account-token
luis: that role's KMS grant expired yesterday — we were using ephemeral grants for the backup agent
ops-bot: alert: 5 restore attempts failed in the last hour (job: nightly-db-snapshot-restore)
emma: can someone run quick check: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-prod-db` and grep for backup-operator?
sanjay: ran it, no active grant for that role. we rotated CMK last month and the automation didn't re-issue grants.
devon: immediate mitigation: attach kms:Decrypt to the IAM role policy for backup-operator (temporary) or re-issue a grant. prefer grant for least-privilege but attach is fastest to unblock.
luis: agree. will push a temp policy now and then schedule a proper grant refresh in infra.
security-bot: reminder: attaching broad kms:* to roles is audited and will trigger compliance review. keep scope to kms:Decrypt and resource-limited.
emma: if we attach policy, use this minimal policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-efgh"
    }
  ]
}
```
sanjay: applied the temporary policy to `backup-operator`. restore job retried and succeeded (07:28 UTC).
devon: follow-up items: 1) re-issue grant automation in rotation lambda, 2) add pre-rotation test that validates grant presence, 3) add CloudWatch alarm on DecryptAccessDenied spikes, 4) add runbook entry.
luis: opened infra ticket INFRA-879 to add grant refresh and test harness. ETA 48h.
emma: we also need audit artifacts for compliance: export CloudTrail events for kms:GrantCreate and kms:Decrypt for last 30 days, and attach to ticket.
security-bot: checklist added to ticket: [export trails, snapshot access list, role policy diff, root cause note].
devon: one design note — ephemeral grants are safer but we need robust renew-before-expiry logic. proposed: renew at T-24h and verify decrypt on a canary snapshot.
sanjay: canary test: `aws ec2 describe-snapshots --snapshot-ids snap-0123 --query 'Snapshots[0].Description'` then attempt `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://snap-meta.bin` (pseudo). we'll document exact commands in runbook.
emma: also flag potential data-residency issue: some snapshots live in gov region — confirm KMS alias mapping across partitions.
luis: noted, adding cross-region alias checks to INFRA-879.
devon: finally, add automated audit log alert: if kms:GrantCreate isn't followed by a grant with matching RetiringPrincipal within 1h, create a pager. small script can poll list-grants.
sanjay: thanks everyone. action owners: luis grant automation (INFRA-879), emma compliance exports, devon runbook + alarm, sanjay validate canary test and update playbook. I'll update incidents channel with summary after ticket updates. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident update posted to #incidents: "KMS grant expiry caused nightly restore failures; temp policy applied; remediation ticket INFRA-879 opened."
security-bot: postmortem reminder: tag with severity, timeline, and include proof that new automation prevents recurrence.
